notes.title: New TNC Version! (1.08)
notes.content:
This new version:

- Correct some collision points
- Slightly improves Proloque level design;
- Correct "The New California" logo entry after first scene - Dignity (no more repeating).

As our team is compound by just 2 persons, developer and producer, we will give support and bring improvements as best as we can!

Thanks for your support!

Jaderson and Tainá
